postgresql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION trigger_function() RETURNS TRIGGER AS $BODY$ BEGIN INSERT INTO public.destination_table ( created_at, match_id, player_id, event_type, url, user_id ) VALUES ( NEW.created_at, NEW.match_id, NEW.player_id, NEW.event_type, split_part(NEW.url::text, '?', 1), ((NEW.data -> 'local_storage') -> 'data') ->> 'user_id' ); RETURN NEW; END; $BODY$ LANGUAGE plpgsql
mysql:
drop function if exists trigger_function;
create function trigger_function()
returns TRIGGER
begin
  insert into public.destination_table (
    created_at,
    match_id,
    player_id,
    event_type,
    url,
    user_id
  )
  values (
    NEW.created_at, 
    NEW.match_id, 
    NEW.player_id, 
    NEW.event_type, 
    substring(
      substring_index(
        cast(NEW.url as char),
        '?',
        1
      ),
      case 1
        when 1 then 1
        else (char_length(substring_index(
          cast(NEW.url as char),
          '?',
          (1 - 1)
        )) + char_length('?') + 1)
      end
    ), 
    json_unquote(nullif(
      json_extract(
        json_extract(
          json_extract(
            NEW.data,
            concat('$.', 'local_storage')
          ),
          concat('$.', 'data')
        ),
        concat('$.', 'user_id')
      ),
      cast('null' as json)
    ))
  );
  return NEW;
end;
